item.title: Robin Hill Unveils New Year-Round Soft Play Attraction For 2026
item.description: Robin Hill Adventure Park has announced a major new addition for families — Robin’s Nest, an all-weather indoor soft play centre set to open in March 2026. The new attraction, which takes over the former 4D cinema building, will feature dedicated play zones for toddlers and older children, including an obstacle course, ball pool, interactive LED floor, crawl tubes, and both vertical and spiral slides. item.title: Five Brilliant Brain Teasers For The Week (23/02/26)
item.description: No tricks, no repeats — just five clever challenges to stretch your brain! 1) The Invisible Purchase (Easy) A man walks into a shop and buys something.
